Community • Education • Empowerment

Every girl deserves a place to thrive.

Treasured Hands Ladies Initiative (THLI) is a community-led initiative creating opportunities for girls and young women to learn, connect and grow with confidence.

Through outreach programmes, mentorship and conversations that matter, we work to make dignity, encouragement and practical support accessible to more girls.

Explore our workJoin the community
Who we are

Women supporting women. Girls building futures.

THLI brings people together around education, wellbeing, leadership and community service. Our activities are designed to encourage girls and young women to recognize their value and pursue their goals.

01 / WELLBEING

Dignity and care

Menstrual hygiene awareness and practical support through our Pad a Girl Child outreach.

02 / GROWTH

Learning and mentorship

Conversations, webinars and opportunities to develop confidence and useful life skills.

03 / COMMUNITY

Connection and service

A supportive network of women and volunteers working together for meaningful local impact.
